bullets: Develop your own SVM library (from Scratch)
You may use any Quadratic Programming solver (e.g. quadprog, CVXOPT, ..) to solve the Lagrangian Equation.
Make use of Kernel functions (e.g. Quadratic , Polynomial, or RBF)
For each of the given dataset (2-D):
Draw the dataset points using color coding (assign same color to points belong to same class)
Divide the background into grid, classify each point in the grid, give each point same color code of the class it belongs to.
